coordinate_scope: Declared source-pixel translations describe selected graphical paths. Printed text is placed relative to those components or ordinary TeX flow. No full-scan font-bound equivalence is asserted. Fixed inner origins use baseline=0pt, use-as-bounding-box, and zero-separation base-west anchors.
workflow: Source-only mechanical assembly; no images, ink choices, OCR, research, TeX compilation/rendering, installation, final-page writes, or commits.

structural_source_report_pass.coordinate_work: Root-declared translations and fixed-origin wrapper maps are recorded. This is source-coordinate bookkeeping; no numerical bounds or extrema calculation or mathematical proof was performed.
